measurements.name: runtime_api_load
measurements.detail: StarlightMap::from_csv_path (the public runtime parsing API) rejects the candidate: it only understands the healpix_index,... schema used by validated external/manual-seed maps, not the nsb-healpix-starlight-candidate-v5 schema (pixel,flux_ph_m2_s,...) the Gaia production pipeline writes. StarlightModel::BundledProductionGaiaDr3 (issue #89) is expected to add runtime support for this schema; no runtime load timing exists for the current candidate yet.
measurements.observed_error: data parse error in starlight map csv: unsupported starlight map header "pixel,flux_ph_m2_s,statistical_uncertainty_ph_m2_s,systematic_uncertainty_ph_m2_s,total_uncertainty_ph_m2_s,admitted_sources,excluded_sources"

measurements.name: proxy_read_and_parse
measurements.detail: Not the validated production load path (that also checksums the file and cross-checks merge_report.json via `dataset starlight validate`). This is a crude proxy: read the file to a string, then iterate every CSV row with the same csv-crate settings (comment='#', full trim) nsb::components::starlight::map already uses for the healpix_index schema, without semantic validation. Five consecutive single-process runs on an otherwise-idle machine; no warm-up discarded, no statistical trimming.

deferred_metrics.name: validated_runtime_load
deferred_metrics.reason: Requires StarlightModel::BundledProductionGaiaDr3 (issue #89), which is not implemented yet. Cannot be measured without inventing a fake timing path.

deferred_metrics.name: dataset_starlight_validate_wall_clock
deferred_metrics.reason: `nsb-data dataset starlight validate --config <run.toml>` re-checksums the full map and merge_report.json and requires a run configuration and outputs directory beyond the two frozen files checked into this repository; deferred to keep this measurement lightweight and local. Should be captured as part of the #90 RC matrix run once the candidate is regenerated under #94.

deferred_metrics.name: criterion_lookup_benchmarks
deferred_metrics.reason: cargo bench -p nsb --bench threshold_window already covers experimental starlight lookup/composition timing (see docs/specifications/performance.md); it does not exercise the Gaia candidate map and was not rerun here to keep this a lightweight local measurement rather than a full benchmark pass.

notes: Reproduce with: cargo run --release -p nsb --example starlight_candidate_load_benchmark. This file records what could honestly be measured today: file size, and a crude read+parse proxy timing, both against the currently invalidated candidate (see #94). It intentionally does not report a runtime load timing, because no runtime API accepts this candidate's schema yet, and does not report Criterion-grade statistics, because that would overstate the rigor of a single-process local run. This should be re-measured against the regenerated candidate once #94 lands, and again once #89 adds runtime support so the real runtime_api_load path can be timed.
